answer: Sybil resistance can be achieved through a verifiable reputation staking mechanism. Agents must accrue trust by consistently contributing provable work or staking valuable resources, establishing a verifiable history. This makes each legitimate agent an economic oasis. To spoof an established orchard of such identities, an attacker faces a prohibitive cost, pushing the feasibility of widespread identity forgery beyond the immediate horizon of economic viability. The attacker must expend equivalent effort or capital per fake identity.
